name: App Store
label: App Store
description: Install and manage the apps shipped with kody-os.

files.index.html:
Install and manage the apps shipped with kody-os, right here in the browser — no agent needed.

The list below is the whole catalog plus every installed app, in one place. Install a catalog app to add it, or use a row's controls to pin it, hide it, add it to the home dashboard, update it, or restore it to its shipped version. Updates never run on their own.

For a custom app that is not in the catalog, ask an agent to add it with MCP add_app. Removing an app is agent-only, through MCP remove_app.
